cross_model.activation: User execution request after v2 robustness assessment

preprocessing.numeric: median, missing indicator, StandardScaler; all-missing columns retained with 0
preprocessing.categorical: frozen role dictionary, missing category, OneHotEncoder unknown ignore

preprocessing_clarifications.numeric: Existing feature values; infinities to NaN; Train median with empty=0; indicators for Train-missing columns; Train StandardScaler mean=True std=True
preprocessing_clarifications.categorical: Frozen original role dictionary; real values prefixed value:; missing: reserved level; Train one-hot vocabulary plus reserved missing; unknown ignored
preprocessing_clarifications.feature_order: Original feature lists; numeric then categorical expansion
preprocessing_clarifications.representation_scope: Same source features; preprocessing differs from LightGBM

inference.estimand_LR: Candidate minus baseline within one fitted LR per fold
inference.estimand_model_difference: LR component effect minus mean of five paired LightGBM component effects within the same time-block draw
inference.core_contrasts: Original core contrasts; all folds and score stages
inference.auxiliary: Original bundle/primary/entity contrasts; all four budget means; PaySim complete capacity-cost threshold grid; primary transferred-threshold recall, cost and alert-rate intervals
inference.ci: Pointwise 95% percentile; linear quantiles; fixed models and windows
inference.invalid: Retain NaN draws, no redraw; report denominator and invalid fraction
inference.interpretation: No effect difference inferred from marginal CI labels; direct paired effect differences only. No blind validation claim.

stopping_rule: Engineering/integrity failure only; never stop or substitute by outcome
failure_policy: Nonconvergence after fixed retry reported; failed fits lack formal inference
publication: Local manuscript copies and package only; no external submission/upload
